facts.image: red line = trace, yellow dot = click; panels: close-up, slice 0, slice 19

text: This trace can generally be trusted, as it was found in 19 of 20 slices with 90.3% within 5 voxels and a median distance of 1.7 voxels, and it is on the clicked layer. It is weakest for precise placement, with only 56.6% within 2 voxels, particularly in the far view like slice 19 where the red line sits among many close layers. A person should check the red line against the yellow dot click in the close-up and compare slice 0 and slice 19 to confirm it stays on the same sheet. Remember it was much farther off before the fix, with only 22.2% within 5 voxels and a median distance of 23.0 voxels.
